description: Single machine-readable source for Nexora billing truth. Human mirror: BILLING-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md. Validated by validate-ops.mjs. Any change requires a commercial freeze decision.

ai.note: Implementation fee and recurring monthly fee are separate. Recurring billing starts at Go-Live. AI support is included within the relevant subscription. No AI Care. No separate standard AI support invoice.

web.note: B3 is bespoke. There is no standard B3 percentage schedule; the schedule is defined per-proposal. Final handover remains subject to the required project balance being paid.

complete.note: The 30/30/30/10 schedule totals 100%. The first 30% is part of the total, not an additional deposit. Never bill a 30% deposit plus 100% of the project. AI implementation remains commercially identifiable where applicable. AI recurring starts at Go-Live. Care remains optional.

care.note: Monthly, paid in advance. No indefinite rollover. Care is separately identifiable from project invoices and is never silently bundled into the project price.

invoice_terms.note: Proposal expiry (30 days) is not the invoice due date (7 calendar days). The proposal validity and the invoice due date are separate concepts.

vat.note: VAT status is NOT commercially resolved. Do not assert registered/unregistered, 20%, inclusive or exclusive without validated accounting input. Invoice templates must support tax fields without making a tax determination.
